description: This is a rectangular, full-length mirror with a decorative frame. The frame appears to be made of a textured, possibly aged material, with an organic, vine-like pattern. At each of the four corners of the frame, there is a small, stylized skull. The mirror itself has an unusual luminescence. The top half of the reflective surface emits a greenish glow, while the bottom half emanates an orange-yellow light, suggesting a mystical or otherworldly quality. The background is completely black, emphasizing the illuminated mirror.
material: unknown (appears to be textured, possibly resin or sculpted material for frame)
